description: Windenergieanlage (Potenzial) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rips-dienste.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de. Representation service for the geotope Determined wind potential area. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS wind turbine (potential)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
